mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(MEMBER_CREATED_AT) = CURDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS todayCount, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(MEMBER_CREATED_AT) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) As yesterdayCount FROM MEMBER WHERE DATE(MEMBER_CREATED_AT) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, IFNULL((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER WHERE YEAR(MEMBER_CREATED_AT) = YEAR(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AND MONTH(MEMBER_CREATED_AT) = MONTH(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH))), 0) AS lastMonthCount FROM MEMBER;

SELECT IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT) = CURDATE() THEN ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE END) ,0) AS todayPrice, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE END), 0) AS yesterdayPrice FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_CREATED_AT >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT IFNULL(COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT) = CURDATE() THEN 1 END), 0) AS todayOrders, IFNULL(COUNT(CASE WHEN DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN 1 END), 0) AS yesterdayOrders FROM ORDERS WHERE DATE(ORDER_CREATED_AT) >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT MONTH(ORDER_CREATED_AT) AS month, IFNULL(SUM(ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE), 0) AS revenue FROM ORDERS WHERE YEAR(ORDER_CREATED_AT) = #{year} AND ORDER_STATUS != 'READY' GROUP BY MONTH(ORDER_CREATED_AT) ORDER BY month ASC;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'PAID' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'SHIPPING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shippingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'SHIPPED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS shippedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doneCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ORDER_STATUS = 'CANCEL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelCount FROM ORDERS

SELECT M.MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, SUM(O.ORDER_TOTAL_PRICE) AS totalAmount, COUNT(O.ORDER_ID) AS orderCount FROM MEMBER M JOIN ORDERS O ON M.MEMBER_ID = O.MEMBER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS != 'CANCEL' GROUP BY M.MEMBER_ID, M.MEMBER_NAME ORDER BY totalAmount DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, SUM(OI.ORDER_ITEM_QTY) AS totalQty FROM ORDER_ITEM OI JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID JOIN ORDERS O ON OI.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_STATUS = 'DONE' GROUP BY P.PRODUCT_ID ORDER BY totalQty DESC LIMIT 5;
